title: Patch: the card sheet's statistics, the creator's script check and a finished GIF's share offer a way on after a failure
thread:
**Issue #1818 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #1818: Patch: the card sheet's statistics, the creator's script check and a finished GIF's share offer a way on after a failure Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means Three places still show "that failed" with no way forward, where the rest of the app already offers a Try again button. A player opening a card's Statistics block during a network blip reads "Statistics unavailable" until they close the sheet. A card creator whose one-time script check fails to load finds Save stays dead until they type a stray character. And a player whose finished GIF fails at the phone's share sheet has to re-encode the whole thing to try again. After this change each offers a retry that re-runs only the failed step. ## Why The Try-again-on-a-dead-end pattern is established (#1706, #1766, #1783); these three surfaces predate or miss it: - `apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx:60-66` renders "Statistics unavailable" with no retry, and the load effect runs once per card (lines 25-49). Its sibling in the same sheet, `CardHistory` (`apps/web/src/patches/CardHistory.tsx:68-72`), already pairs the alert with Try again, and the `/stats` route retries too. - `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx:261-265` shows the script-check alert, but the `useScriptCheck` effect re-runs only when `source`/`check` change (deps at line 124), so a failed lazy load of the checker (`checkCustomCard` via `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts`) leaves `scriptReady` false and Save dead until the source text changes. The creator's own card-list failure already offers Try again (lines 441-447). - `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx:160-166`: `send()`'s catch flips `phase` to `{ kind: "failed" }`, discarding the `{ kind: "ready", file }` state — so a share-sheet failure costs a full re-encode. ## Proposal - `CardStatsBlock`: a Try again that re-runs the load (a reload counter in the effect's deps, as sibling blocks do). - `Creator`: a retry on the script-check alert that re-invokes the check, clearing the dead Save without touching the source. - `ShareGif`: keep the `ready` phase's file when share fails and offer Share again on the failure view — retry calls `send()` with the kept file, never re-encoding. ## Where it lands `apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx`, `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx` + its `useScriptCheck` hook, `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx`, and their tests. No engine or spec surface. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Each of the three failure views offers a retry that runs only the failed step. - [ ] The GIF retry does not re-encode. - [ ] One test per surface drives failure -> retry -> success. - [ ] Happy paths unchanged. ## Size and risks Medium: three small surfaces, ~6-8 files. Each is a local state change; retries stay manual, so no retry loop. The rest of the app was surveyed first — every other async surface already retries or self-heals. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-3` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/40159328096)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal Three error views in `apps/web` get a **Try again** button that re-runs only the step that failed: - the card sheet's statistics block reloads the stats; - the creator's script-check alert runs the check again on the same source, so Save comes back without an edit; - a failed GIF share keeps the GIF it already made, and Try again hands that same file to the share sheet again without re-encoding. Each surface gets one test that goes failure → retry → success. The existing tests still pass, which shows the normal paths are unchanged. ## Files to touch | Path | new/change | What | |---|---|---| | `apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx` | change | `attempt` state in the load effect's deps; a Try again button in the error view, shown only on a load error | | `apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.css` | change | new rule `.inspect-stats-retry` | | `apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.test.tsx` | change | import `fireEvent`; const `SPARK_PUP`; new `describe` with 2 tests | | `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx` | change | `useScriptCheck` returns `[ScriptCheck, () => void]`; `Editor`'s script-check alert gets Try again | | `apps/web/src/creator/testids.ts` | change | `checkRetry: "creator-check-retry"` | | `apps/web/src/creator/Creator.test.tsx` | change | new `describe` with 1 test | | `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx` | change | `type GifReady`; the `failed` variant of `GifPhase` gets `ready: GifReady \| null`; `make`'s catch; `send`; `gifTestid.retry`; retry button in `ShareGif` | | `apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.test.tsx` | change | 2 assertions added to "an export that fails says why"; 1 new test | Do not touch: `apps/web/src/wasm/index.ts` (`luauBindings` already sets `luau = null` after a failed load, so a second check imports the module again), `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` (it already has `"Try again"`, and `i18n.test.ts` requires a zh-CN entry for every `t()` literal, so add no new sentence), `e2e/` (its testids file copies only the ids the e2e specs use), every crate, `spec/`, `crates/cards/patches/` (a client-only change needs no patch fragment, like #1811). No spec section or ruling governs this: §9.11, §12.9 and R513000 say nothing about retrying, so the change adds no ruling. ## Steps 1. **`apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.tsx`, `CardStatsBlock`.** - Right after `const [error, setError] = useState(false);` add: ```tsx /** Bumped by Try again, which loads the card's statistics again. */ const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0); ``` - Change the load effect's deps from `[cardId]` to `[cardId, attempt]`. Leave the effect body alone: it already resets `loading` and `error`. - In the `if (error || !stat)` view, right after the `

…

` line, add: ```tsx {error ? ( ) : null} ``` - Add no testid. A new `INSPECT_*` id would have to be copied into e2e's A14 block, so the test finds the button by its role instead. 2. **`apps/web/src/cards/inspect/inspect.css`.** Right after the `.inspect-stats-loading, .inspect-stats-unavailable { … }` rule, add: ```css .inspect-stats-retry { align-self: flex-start; } ``` `.inspect-stats` is a flex column, so without this rule the button would stretch across the whole block. 3. **`apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx`, `useScriptCheck`.** - Change the signature to `function useScriptCheck(card: CustomCard, check: CreatorApi["check"]): [ScriptCheck, () => void]`. - After the `result` state, add: ```tsx /** Bumped by the failed check's Try again, which asks again for the same script. */ const [attempt, setAttempt] = useState(0); ``` - Change the effect deps to `[source, check, attempt]`. - Replace `return result;` with: ```tsx const retry = useCallback(() => setAttempt((before) => before + 1), []); return [result, retry]; ``` `useCallback` is already imported. - Add one sentence to the hook's doc comment: "The second value asks again after a check that failed, with no edit." 4. **`apps/web/src/creator/Creator.tsx`, `Editor`.** - Change `const script = useScriptCheck(card, check);` to `const [script, retryCheck] = useScriptCheck(card, check);`. - Replace the `script.kind === "failed"` block's `

…

` with the following. It copies the stale-save block's layout: ```tsx

{t("The script could not be checked: {message}", { message: script.message })}

``` 5. **`apps/web/src/creator/testids.ts`.** Right after `checking: "creator-checking",` add `checkRetry: "creator-check-retry",`. 6. **`apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.tsx`.** - In `gifTestid`, after `share: "replay-gif-share",` add `retry: "replay-gif-retry",`. - Replace the `GifPhase` type with: ```ts /** A made GIF, and whether the device can hand it to the share sheet (else Share downloads it). */ type GifReady = { kind: "ready"; file: File; share: boolean }; export type GifPhase = | { kind: "idle" } | { kind: "working"; frame: number; frames: number; attempt: number; attempts: number } | GifReady | { kind: "tooBig" } // `ready`: the made GIF whose share failed, which Try again shares again without drawing it anew; // null when the export itself failed, where Make GIF is the way on. | { kind: "failed"; message: string; ready: GifReady | null }; ``` - In `make`'s `catch`, add `ready: null` to the `setPhase({ kind: "failed", … })` object. - Replace the body of `send` with: ```ts // Share, or Try again after a share that failed: the made GIF either way, never drawn again. const ready = phase.kind === "ready" ? phase : phase.kind === "failed" ? phase.ready : null; if (ready === null || loaded.current === null) return; setPhase(ready); loaded.current.shareGif(ready.file).catch((cause: unknown) => { // A dismissed share sheet is the viewer's answer, not a failure. if (!isAbort(cause)) setPhase({ kind: "failed", message: cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : String(cause), ready }); }); ``` `shareGif` must still be called synchronously inside the click. It is, because `loaded.current` is already set. - In `ShareGif`, right after the `phase.kind === "failed"` alert block, add: ```tsx {phase.kind === "failed" && phase.ready !== null ? ( ) : null} ``` 7. Add the tests below. ## Tests **`apps/web/src/stats/CardStatsBlock.test.tsx`** - Add `fireEvent` to the `@testing-library/react` import. - After `afterEach`, add `const SPARK_PUP = {…}`, a copy of the `core-001` card object from the first test. - Add a new `describe("CardStatsBlock after a load that failed", …)`, with no R-id in any title: - `it("offers Try again, which loads the card's statistics again")`: - Set up `const fetchMock = vi.fn().mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")).mockResolvedValueOnce(new Response(JSON.stringify(mockStatsResponse(SPARK_PUP)), { status: 200 }))`, then `vi.stubGlobal("fetch", fetchMock)` and render `cardId="core-001"`. - `await screen.findByText("Statistics unavailable", undefined, SLOW)`. - `fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Try again" }))`. - `await screen.findByText("Played Δ", undefined, SLOW)`; `"+20%"` is shown; `"Statistics unavailable"` is gone; `fetchMock` was called 2 times. - `it("offers no Try again when the server has no statistics for the card")`: - fetch resolves `mockStatsResponse({ ...SPARK_PUP, id: "core-002" })`; render `cardId="core-001"`. - "Statistics unavailable" is shown, and `queryByRole("button", { name: "Try again" })` is absent. **`apps/web/src/creator/Creator.test.tsx`.** Add at the end a new `describe("the creator's script check, when it fails", …)`: - `it("offers Try again, which checks the same script again and frees Save without an edit")`: - `const server = fakeServer(); vi.mocked(server.api.check).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("the Luau module did not load"));`, then render ``. - `await screen.findByText("0 of 50 cards")`, then `type(creatorTestid.name, "Spark Lancer")`. - `await screen.findByText("The script could not be checked: the Luau module did not load")`. - Save is disabled; `check` was called 1 time; keep `const source = vi.mocked(server.api.check).mock.calls[0]?.[0].source`. - Click `creatorTestid.checkRetry`. - `await waitFor(() => expect(save.disabled).toBe(false))`. - `check` was called 2 times, and `calls[1]?.[0].source` is `source`. - `queryByText(/could not be checked/u)` and `queryByTestId(creatorTestid.checkRetry)` are both null. **`apps/web/src/replay/ShareGif.test.tsx`** - In "an export that fails says why", add after the existing expect: - `expect(screen.queryByTestId(gifTestid.retry)).toBeNull();` - `expect(screen.getByTestId(gifTestid.make)).toBeEnabled();` - Add as the last `it` in the describe, `it("a share that fails offers Try again, which shares the made GIF again without drawing it anew")`: - `await open()`; `exporting.mockResolvedValue(READY)`; `canShareFile` returns `true`; `vi.mocked(shareGif).mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error("the share sheet fell over")).mockResolvedValueOnce("shared")`. - `await make()`, then `fireEvent.click(await screen.findByTestId(gifTestid.share))`. - `await screen.findByTestId(gifTestid.failed)` has the text "the share sheet fell over"; `gifTestid.share` is absent. - `click(gifTestid.retry)`. - `shareGif` was called 2 times, last with `GIF_FILE`; `exporting` was called 1 time. - `await waitFor` until `gifTestid.failed` is gone; `gifTestid.retry` is absent; `gifTestid.share` has the text "Share". Run (`sh scripts/build-wasm.sh` first, once): ``` pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/stats/CardStatsBlock.test.tsx src/creator/Creator.test.tsx src/replay/ShareGif.test.tsx src/i18n/i18n.test.ts pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/stats apps/web/src/creator apps/web/src/replay ``` I ran a probe before writing this. I applied the exact code above to untracked copies of the three components and ran these tests against them: all passed. Against the unchanged components only the three new tests failed. eslint was clean, and tsc showed no errors beyond the Luau package I had not built. ## Done when - [ ] Stats: Try again appears on a failed load and reloads only the stats; it does not appear when the card has no stats. - [ ] Creator: Try again on the script-check alert runs the check again on the same source and frees Save. - [ ] GIF: Try again after a failed share hands the kept file to the share sheet again with no new `exportGif` call; an export failure shows no Try again. - [ ] The 4 new tests pass; every existing test in the three files and `i18n.test.ts` still passes. - [ ] Web typecheck and eslint pass, plus the harness's web tests. No Rust files change, so rustfmt, clippy, cargo tests and the spec, catalog and patches checks are unaffected. ## Risks - **GIF share and the user gesture.** `navigator.share` only works during a click, so `send` must call `shareGif` synchronously in the click handler. Do not put an `await` or an `import()` before it. - **`setPhase(ready)` before the share.** It removes the failure alert at once. A dismissed sheet (`AbortError`) leaves the phase at `ready`, as today. - **Creator retry delay.** The retry goes back through the effect, so it waits `CHECK_DELAY_MS` before checking; the test's `waitFor` covers that. The stale-answer guard (`asked`) still drops any older answer. - **Retries are manual only.** Nothing retries on a timer, so nothing can loop. - Hidden information and rule 7 are not involved: each change only re-runs a request the client already made. ## Open questions None needs a person. Decisions I made, with the alternative I rejected: 1. **Label "Try again" on all three**, not "Share again" on the GIF. "Try again" is the app's established label (#1706, #1766, #1783) and already has a zh-CN entry; "Share again" would need a new one. 2. **Stats Try again only on a load error**, not also when the server has no stats for the card. Re-fetching would return the same empty answer, so it would not move the player on. 3. **The creator's retry re-runs the existing effect** through an `attempt` counter, not a separate immediate check. That avoids a second code path, and the 300 ms wait is negligible. 4. **No retry after a failed GIF export.** There is no made GIF to keep, and Make GIF is already enabled in that state. 5. **No testid for the stats button.** The test finds it by role, so e2e's A14 testid block needs no new entry. --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-10-25T03:33:55Z: approve ````
